title: teoria-blocchi/1: the Teoria pages cut into citable blocks
description: Written by `teoria-blocchi DIR OUT` (crates/mzlab-tutor). Canonical: keys in alphabetical order, one block per line, same bytes for the same pages. Exercise blocks (kind esercizio) hold only the question; the hidden answer appears as a SHA and as hashed 5-word shingles, never as text.

chapters.description: page name (without .html) -> title of the page

id.description: file#anchor.k, k = order of the block under that anchor

anchor.description: id of the heading or glossary term the block sits under; empty before the first h2

chapter.description: kicker of the page ("Capitolo 12"), or its title when it has none

title.description: title of the section (h2/h3), or the glossary term

sha.description: first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the normalised text

hidden_sha.description: same for the hidden answer (esercizio only)

hidden_shingles.description: sorted 6-hex hashes of the 5-word shingles of the hidden answer
